exam.exam_name: Kerala PSC Degree Level Common Preliminary Examination (Kerala PSC Degree Prelims)
exam.conducting_body: Kerala Public Service Commission (Kerala PSC), Thiruvananthapuram

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidates must upload photograph of 150 px width and 200 px height, size not exceeding 30 KB, with candidate's name and date of photograph taken printed at the bottom.
source_evidence.document_title: Gazette Notification for Degree Level Common Preliminary Examination for Graduate Posts

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: Width 150 pixels x Height 200 pixels; strictly max 30 KB

spectacles.source_wording: Prescription spectacles allowed without tint; no glare or reflection

headwear.condition: Caps/hats prohibited; religious headwear permitted if face is clearly exposed
headwear.source_wording: Caps/hats prohibited; religious headwear permitted if face is clearly exposed

unsupported_requirement_reasons: The body requires the candidate's name and/or the photograph date printed on the image. The engine has no text-rendering capability, so the photograph is produced correctly sized and composed but without the imprint, which the candidate must add before uploading.

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; Width 150 pixels x Height 200 pixels; strictly max 30 KB; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm proportional; Plain white or light background; Automated validation by Kerala PSC Thulasi portal enforcing exact 150x200 px and < 30 KB limit
requirements.notes: One Time Registration (OTR) Profile on Thulasi Portal

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; Width 150 pixels x Height 100 pixels; strictly max 30 KB; 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm proportional; Plain white background; Running hand signature; block letters or initials only are invalid; Thulasi portal validates exact 150x100 px and size <= 30 KB

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Gazette Notification for Degree Level Common Preliminary Examination for Graduate Posts - One Time Registration Photo Specifications (https://thulasi.psc.kerala.gov.in)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Gazette Notification for Degree Level Common Preliminary Examination for Graduate Posts - One Time Registration Photo Specifications (https://thulasi.psc.kerala.gov.in)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
